abstract: Aging trajectories vary among individuals of similar age and disease burden. Comorbidity indices, e.g. the Elixhauser index, aggregate recorded conditions into a single score, but discard the timing, sequence, and pace of morbidity accumulation. Here we ask whether longitudinal hospital diagnosis histories contain information beyond age, sex, and comorbidity burden, and where it is concentrated. Using 13 years of Austrian inpatient data covering 7.4 million patients, we trained a visit-level contrastive transformer to encode diagnosis sequences and inter-admission timing into patient-history embeddings. In a downstream cohort of 1.7 million individuals, the embedding model improved prediction of in-hospital death over the Elixhauser-based comorbidity model, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.879 versus 0.866 (AUC gain = 0.0132, 95% CI 0.0118–0.0144). Across 130 incident ICD-10 disease-block outcomes, the embedding model had higher AUC for 93 outcomes, with a modest median gain of 0.006. Gains were concentrated in mental, musculoskeletal, nervous system, and metabolic disorders. We then evaluated event-free survival, defined as remaining alive without accumulating a second unrecorded ICD-10 disease block. The embedding model achieved an AUC of 0.726 versus 0.722 for the comorbidity model. However, among patients with similar age, sex, and comorbidity-model risk, those assigned high residual risk had 127–181 fewer event-free days over five years and observed event rates comparable to low-residual-risk patients more than a decade older. Together, these findings link the embedding’s signal to the breadth, recency, and pace of prior disease accumulation.
zh_abstract: 衰老轨迹在年龄和疾病负担相似的个体之间存在差异。合并症指数，例如 Elixhauser 指数，将记录的疾病汇总为单一评分，但丢弃了发病累积的时间、顺序和速度。在此，我们探讨纵向住院诊断史是否包含年龄、性别和合并症负担之外的信息，以及这些信息集中于何处。利用覆盖 740 万患者的 13 年奥地利住院数据，我们训练了一个就诊层面的对比 transformer，将诊断序列和住院间隔时间编码为患者病史嵌入。在一个由 170 万个体组成的下游队列中，嵌入模型较基于 Elixhauser 的合并症模型改善了院内死亡预测，曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.879 对 0.866（AUC 增益 = 0.0132，95% CI 0.0118–0.0144）。在 130 个新发 ICD-10 疾病区块结局中，嵌入模型对 93 个结局具有更高的 AUC，中位增益不大，为 0.006。增益集中于精神、肌肉骨骼、神经系统和代谢性疾病。随后我们评估了无事件生存，定义为仍存活且未累积第二个未记录的 ICD-10 疾病区块。嵌入模型达到 AUC 0.726，而合并症模型为 0.722。然而，在年龄、性别和合并症模型风险相似的患者中，被分配为高残余风险者五年内无事件天数少 127–181 天，其观察到的事件率与年龄大十岁以上的低残余风险患者相当。总之，这些发现将嵌入的信号与既往疾病累积的广度、近期性和速度联系起来。

abstract: Abstract Although AI tools for neuroimaging show considerable promise in the diagnosis, prognosis, and management of neurodegenerative disorders, their uptake in memory clinics has been limited. A key barrier is lack of consensus on their effective design and implementation. Here we establish expert consensus on the specific goals, usage and challenges of AI tools for neuroimaging in the memory clinic using a Delphi process. Sixteen experts from clinical, academic, and industry backgrounds participated in three rounds of questionnaires, coordinated by the Imaging Working Group of the Deep Dementia Phenotyping (DEMON) network, with support from a patient and public involvement representative. Consensus was reached on eight statements covering four themes: purpose, quality, interactions with clinicians and memory clinics, and privacy and ethics. Implementation of these recommendations will further the adoption of AI neuroimaging tools from research to clinical practice, improving diagnostic and care pathways for patient benefit.

abstract: Abstract The combination of the Internet of Things (IoT), artificial intelligence (AI), and wearable biosensors is transforming healthcare by allowing continuous, real-time monitoring and more intelligent clinical decision-making. This review explores AI-driven monitoring, smart intravenous (IV) infusion automation, and wearable biosensors, and proposes Intelligent IV Automation and Smart Patient Synchronization (INFUSYNC), a conceptual framework synchronizing monitoring, automated fluid delivery, and predictive analytics. The literature shows meaningful progress: wearables increasingly support non-contact monitoring with near clinical-grade accuracy for select parameters, while infusion pumps with dose-error-reduction and AI-assisted decision support are reported to improve delivery precision and safety. Predictive models further support early detection of physiological decline. Progress remains uneven, however: most AI-enabled infusion systems are prototype-stage, closed-loop control remains rare, and interoperability, data security, and privacy remain underdeveloped. Future systems will need compatible, security-by-design, clinically validated, feedback-controlled architectures. Overall, this review outlines a clear but early-stage trajectory toward integrated smart-health environments for IV therapy.

zh_abstract: 摘要 物联网（Internet of Things, IoT）、人工智能（AI）和可穿戴生物传感器的结合，通过允许持续、实时监测和更智能的临床决策，正在改变医疗保健。本综述探讨了 AI 驱动的监测、智能静脉（IV）输注自动化和可穿戴生物传感器，并提出了智能静脉输注自动化与患者智能同步（Intelligent IV Automation and Smart Patient Synchronization, INFUSYNC），这是一个同步监测、自动液体输送和预测分析的概念框架。文献显示出有意义的进展：可穿戴设备日益支持非接触式监测，对某些参数具有接近临床级的准确性，而具有剂量错误减少和 AI 辅助决策支持的输注泵据报道可提高输送精度和安全性。预测模型进一步支持对生理衰退的早期检测。然而，进展仍不均衡：大多数 AI 赋能的输注系统处于原型阶段，闭环控制仍少见，互操作性、数据安全和隐私仍不完善。未来的系统将需要兼容、设计即安全、经临床验证、反馈控制的架构。总体而言，本综述概述了一条明确但处于早期阶段的轨迹，迈向用于静脉治疗的集成智能健康环境。

abstract: The International Mouse Phenotyping Consortium (IMPC) maintains a large archive of whole-body dorsoventral radiographs. However, heterogeneity in file formats, metadata completeness, orientation, and image quality limits its reuse for large-scale quantitative analysis. We present FERDINAND (Framework for Extracting and Restructuring Distributed IMPC radiographs into a Normalised, AI-ready Navigable Dataset), an open framework for programmatic access, harmonisation, quality control, and curation of IMPC radiographs. FERDINAND combines metadata retrieval and local radiograph archiving with centre-aware preprocessing, automated exposure screening, orientation standardisation, and clustering-assisted visual curation. Applied to IMPC Data Release 24, FERDINAND organises 104,819 radiographs acquired between February 2012 and June 2025 across ten phenotyping centres and 6,306 single-gene knockout mouse lines, with semi-automated curation recorded for every image. As an independent validation of the harmonised output, a DeepLabCut-based bone-morphometry pipeline showed that FERDINAND-processed radiographs improve data efficiency for landmark detection: at reduced training-set sizes, they achieve better performance than original radiographs and require fewer manual annotations to reach a given level of quality. FERDINAND provides a reproducible foundation for artificial intelligence (AI)-ready analysis and scalable quantitative phenotyping of heterogeneous IMPC and comparable radiograph resources. The complete FERDINAND source code is openly available on GitHub.

abstract: Patient-specific phenotype information extraction identifiers and normalizes phenotype entities and links them with individual patients, supporting rare disease research and genotype-phenotype analysis. However, existing datasets rarely combine full-text biomedical content with detailed annotations of patients, phenotypes, related entities, and their associations. In this work, we present PatientPheX, a corpus for patient-specific phenotype information extraction comprising 200 full-text articles, primarily case reports and case series. The corpus provides mention annotations and normalization for seven biomedical entity types, together with explicit associations between patients and entities across sentences, paragraphs, and sections. Negated findings and composite phenotype mentions are also annotated. Corpus construction combines automated pre-annotation, large language model (LLM)-assisted verification, and manual review and adjudication. Benchmarks cover entity recognition and normalization and patient-phenotype association extraction using gold-standard and predicted entities. The overall document-level entity F1 was 86.95%, while phenotype F1 was 79.33%. The best relation extraction macro-F1 decreased from 84.14% with gold-standard entities to 54.98% with predicted entities, highlighting the combined challenges of phenotype extraction and patient attribution. PatientPheX provides a resource for developing and evaluating patient-centered information extraction methods and supports the construction of structured patient-level knowledge resources for phenotype-driven biomedical research.
zh_abstract: 患者特异性表型信息抽取（patient-specific phenotype information extraction）识别并规范化表型实体，并将其与个体患者关联，支持罕见病研究和基因型-表型分析。然而，现有数据集很少将全文生物医学内容与患者、表型、相关实体及其关联的详细标注相结合。在本研究中，我们提出 PatientPheX，一个用于患者特异性表型信息抽取的语料库，包含 200 篇全文文章，主要是病例报告和病例系列。该语料库为七种生物医学实体类型提供提及标注和规范化，并提供跨句子、段落和章节的患者与实体之间的显式关联。否定发现和复合表型提及也进行了标注。语料库构建结合了自动预标注、大型语言模型（LLM）辅助验证以及人工审核和裁定。基准测试涵盖使用金标准和预测实体的实体识别与规范化以及患者-表型关联抽取。整体文档级实体 F1 为 86.95%，而表型 F1 为 79.33%。最佳关系抽取宏 F1 从使用金标准实体时的 84.14% 下降到使用预测实体时的 54.98%，凸显了表型抽取和患者归属的综合挑战。PatientPheX 为开发和评估以患者为中心的信息抽取方法提供了资源，并支持为表型驱动的生物医学研究构建结构化的患者级知识资源。

title: SVC: A Vision Transformer-based Spatially and Virtually Embedded Cell Model for Deciphering Subcellular Spatial Transcriptomic Heterogeneity

abstract: Subcellular transcript localization shapes gene regulation and cellular function, yet profiling it at scale remains difficult, limiting our ability to study subcellular heterogeneity across tissues and disease. Here, we present SVC, a Vision Transformer-based spatially and virtually embedded cell model that learns subcellular transcript organization within native tissue context directly from subcellular-resolution spatial transcriptomics. SVC represents each gene's subcellular localization as an image patch and uses other genes within the same cell as context, enabling subcellular contextual learning of spatial dependencies that govern intracellular organization. By integrating gene-function priors, cell morphology, spatial context, and, when available, cell identity, SVC captures unified, spatially grounded representations across genes and cells that connect subcellular organization to cellular state and tissue microenvironment. Across diverse subcellular-resolution spatial transcriptomics datasets, SVC accurately predicts cell-specific subcellular transcript localization and co-organization, generalizes across tissues and technical platforms, and supports subcellular imputation of unmeasured genes and in silico perturbation. Leveraging these capabilities, SVC highlights disease-associated patterns of intracellular transcript reorganization and spatially heterogeneous responses to gene perturbations. Beyond prediction, SVC reveals systematic variation in subcellular transcript organization associated with gene function, cellular states, and tissue microenvironments, uncovering de novo spatial biology that is not accessible by cell-level analysis. SVC's learned representations further transfer to cell- and tissue-level tasks, including cell-level expression imputation, cell clustering, and spatial domain detection. Together, SVC provides a general framework for modeling and interrogating subcellular transcript organization in situ, enabling scalable discovery of subcellular spatial biology.

zh_abstract: 亚细胞转录本定位塑造基因调控和细胞功能，然而在规模化水平上对其进行分析仍然困难，限制了我们在组织和疾病中研究亚细胞异质性的能力。在此，我们提出 SVC，一种基于 Vision Transformer（视觉 Transformer）的空间和虚拟嵌入细胞模型，可直接从亚细胞分辨率空间转录组学中学习天然组织背景内的亚细胞转录本组织。SVC 将每个基因的亚细胞定位表示为图像块，并使用同一细胞内的其他基因作为上下文，从而实现对支配细胞内组织的空间依赖性的亚细胞上下文学习。通过整合基因功能先验、细胞形态、空间上下文以及（在可用时）细胞身份，SVC 捕获跨基因和细胞的统一、空间锚定的表征，将亚细胞组织与细胞状态和组织微环境联系起来。在多种亚细胞分辨率空间转录组学数据集上，SVC 准确预测细胞特异性亚细胞转录本定位和共组织，可跨组织和技术平台泛化，并支持未测量基因的亚细胞插补和计算机扰动。利用这些能力，SVC 突出疾病相关的细胞内转录本重组织模式以及对基因扰动的空间异质性反应。超越预测，SVC 揭示与基因功能、细胞状态和组织微环境相关的亚细胞转录本组织的系统性变异，发现细胞水平分析无法获取的从头空间生物学。SVC 学到的表征进一步迁移到细胞和组织水平任务，包括细胞水平表达插补、细胞聚类和空间域检测。总之，SVC 提供了一个在原位建模和探究亚细胞转录本组织的通用框架，使得可扩展地发现亚细胞空间生物学成为可能。

title: From Closed-Set Annotation to In-Context Discovery: Biologically Grounded LLMs for Cellular Profiling

summary: 预印本提出CellScribe，以AdaLN适配器将语言模型条件于单细胞基础模型嵌入，统一输出细胞类型与元程序谱。

abstract: Tumour heterogeneity reflects both cellular identity (lineage) and state (active transcriptional programs), yet computational methods generally analyse these axes separately. We introduce CellScribe, a generative framework that conditions a pretrained language model on frozen single cell foundation model embeddings through AdaLN adapters, enabling one shared model to generate an ontology- grounded cell type or a quantified meta-program profile. Supervised multitask fine- tuning produces fine grained typing across hundreds of cell types and outperforms generative and retrieval baselines on meta-program identification under study-holdout evaluation. We further train the model with reinforcement learning, scoring its generations against cell ontology distance and meta-program agreement, so that they align with biological knowledge rather than token agreement. To identify new cell types not present in the supervised training data, we post-train the model to read several labelled example cells in a single context, each conditioning its own text span, and infer the type of a query cell through in-context learning. CellScribe thus unifies cell identity and state in one generative interface, grounds both in biological structure, and identifies cell types outside the supervised vocabulary.

title: Protein novelty, sequence similarity, and negative sampling controls reveal benchmark specific discrimination in protein protein interactionprediction

summary: 预印本重估Guo酵母基准，显示随机划分高估PPI预测性能，训练测试均未见的蛋白对AUC明显下降。

abstract: Protein protein interaction (PPI) predictors are often evaluated with random pair splits that permit proteins to recur across training and test sets, while constructed negative pairs can introduce a separate source of benchmark-specific signal. We reassessed the Guo yeast benchmark using a matched protein novelty curve, independently generated MMseqs2 sequence cluster controlled R3 variants, topology only controls, degree- and length matched putative negatives, handcrafted and frozen protein language model representations, multiple model configurations, seed analyses, and connected component aware inference. In the matched R1[->]R2[->]R3 comparison, AAC+CTD-MLP ROC-AUC declined from 0.697 for seen-seen pairs to 0.626 for one-unseen pairs and 0.587 for both-unseen pairs. Across independently regenerated cluster-disjoint R3 variants at 50%, 40%, 30%, and 20% MMseqs2 clustering thresholds, performance showed no consistent monotonic trend. Guo original-negative endpoints had lower positive-network degree than positive endpoints (mean 3.34 versus 6.72), and a degree-only logistic model reached ROC-AUC 0.962 on the original negatives but 0.502 on degree-matched negatives. We used degree-matched negatives consistently for R3 training and testing; six sequence based model configurations yielded ROC-AUC 0.493- 0.547; none showed corrected connected-component-aware evidence of above-chance discrimination. A PIPR multispecies analysis reproduced degree-associated label separation but also exposed cross-species pairing as an additional pooled cue. These results show that protein novelty, operational sequence cluster separation, and negative-set topology are distinct dimensions of PPI benchmark evaluation. The Guo result is benchmark-specific and should not be generalized to sequence-based PPI prediction or protein language models overall. The dataset and source code for the experiments are publicly available at https://github.com/morufwork/guoAudit.git.

abstract: Personalized neoantigen-targeting cancer vaccines in the adjuvant setting are of increasing interest across malignancies. Here we report the results of a phase 1 clinical trial testing the feasibility and safety of personalized neoantigen-targeting cancer vaccines for high-grade epithelial ovarian cancer. ‘NeoVax’ consisted of pools of synthetic long peptides targeting patient-specific neoantigens admixed with the immunostimulant poly-ICLC, was combined with delayed administration of anti-PD-1 antibody, and was tested in ten patients (one newly diagnosed patient (Cohort A) and nine patients at first recurrence (Cohort B)) with platinum-sensitive ovarian cancer following standard-of-care platinum doublet chemotherapy. Nine of 12 evaluable Cohort B patients were vaccinated (75%, 90% CI 47–93%) and 1 of 9 Cohort A patients (11%, 90% CI 0.6–43%). No unexpected safety signals were encountered and no patients discontinued treatment due to toxicity. Across patients, >70% selected targets remained detectable by noninvasive cell-free DNA analysis despite a median of 6.5 months from the time of diagnostic biopsy to vaccine administration, during which, patients received standard-of-care chemotherapy. Biomarker analysis was suggestive of biologic activity of the vaccine in six of ten patients and this was associated with broader tumor and vaccine-specific immune responses in blood and tumor following vaccination. Resistant tumor clones reflected diverse mechanisms affecting antigen presentation, indicative of immune-selective pressure exerted by vaccination. Overall, the interplay between the repertoire of antigens presented by the tumor and the breadth of induced immunity seemed to dictate clinical efficacy following vaccination. ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04024878.

abstract: Declining cognitive function is a growing health challenge, yet how cognitive decline influences time-of-day physical activity (PA) patterns remains underexplored. Among cognitively unimpaired participants from the Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study, we modeled general and domain-specific cognitive trajectories and related them to accelerometry-derived PA a median of 8.2 years later in 811 participants (mean baseline age 73.1 years) using function-on-scalar and multivariable regression. Slower cognitive decline was associated with more favorable midday PA (10 AM–3 PM), including higher movement volume, less sedentary time, fewer interruptions to active periods, and greater activity variability. In adjusted linear regression models, associations with PA patterns derived from a window as short as 11 AM-1 PM were comparable to those with 24-hour measures. The executive function trajectory exhibited the strongest associations with PA patterns, and over the longest period of the day; the language trajectory showed non-linear associations, and the peak association for the memory trajectory with PA occurred in the late morning (10:30–11:30 AM). Associations between cognitive decline and activity variability were stronger than for other PA metrics. Our findings highlight the potential of PA patterns, particularly activity variability, as a non-invasive way to help monitor cognitive decline before clinical impairment emerges.
zh_abstract: 认知功能下降是一个日益严峻的健康挑战，但认知下降如何影响一天中不同时段的身体活动（PA）模式仍未得到充分探索。在社区动脉粥样硬化风险研究（Atherosclerosis Risk in Communities Study）中认知未受损的参与者中，我们对一般认知和领域特异性认知轨迹进行建模，并使用 function-on-scalar 回归和多变量回归，将其与中位 8.2 年后 811 名参与者（基线平均年龄 73.1 岁）通过加速度计得出的 PA 相关联。较慢的认知下降与更有利的午间 PA（上午 10 点至下午 3 点）相关，包括更高的活动量、更少的久坐时间、活动期更少的中断以及更大的活动变异性。在调整后的线性回归模型中，来自短至上午 11 点至下午 1 点时间窗的 PA 模式关联与 24 小时测量的关联相当。执行功能轨迹与 PA 模式的关联最强，且覆盖一天中最长的时间段；语言轨迹显示出非线性关联；记忆轨迹与 PA 的关联峰值出现在上午晚些时候（上午 10:30 至 11:30）。认知下降与活动变异性之间的关联强于其他 PA 指标。我们的发现凸显了 PA 模式，特别是活动变异性，作为一种非侵入性方式帮助在临床损害出现前监测认知下降的潜力。

abstract: The effectiveness of mHealth interventions for improving antimicrobial guideline adherence remains insufficiently understood in resource-limited settings. This study evaluated a context-adapted smartphone Standard Treatment Guideline (STG) app designed to improve physicians’ adherence to antimicrobial treatment guidelines in Ethiopia. A type 1 hybrid effectiveness–implementation cluster-randomized trial was conducted in 20 hospitals randomized to a smartphone app plus training or paper-based guidelines and retrospectively registered (PACTR202504495116733). The primary outcome was guideline-adherent prescribing, defined as correct antibiotic selection, dose, frequency, and duration when treatment was indicated, or appropriately documented non-prescribing when antibiotics were not indicated across 1433 patient charts. Secondary outcomes included overall antibiotic use and broad-spectrum antibiotic use. Guideline adherence improved by 26.7 percentage points in crude difference-in-differences analysis, and the adjusted intervention-by-endline effect showed higher odds of guideline-adherent prescribing (aOR 3.89; 95% CI: 1.96–7.73). Overall, antibiotic use declined from 96.9% to 82.2% in the intervention arm. In a post-hoc sensitivity analysis using all eligible charts, broad-spectrum antibiotic use declined from 83.9 to 57.5%. These findings support the potential value of a multicomponent intervention combining an offline STG app with training and implementation support for improving guideline-concordant antimicrobial prescribing; however, the independent contribution of the mobile application cannot be determined.
zh_abstract: 在资源有限环境中，移动健康（mHealth）干预对改善抗菌药物指南依从性的有效性仍未被充分了解。本研究评估了一款适应具体情境的智能手机标准治疗指南（Standard Treatment Guideline, STG）应用程序，该应用程序旨在提高埃塞俄比亚医生对抗菌药物治疗指南的依从性。研究在20家医院开展了一项1型混合效果-实施整群随机试验，医院被随机分配至智能手机应用程序加培训组或纸质指南组，并进行了回顾性注册（PACTR202504495116733）。主要结局是指南依从性处方，其定义为：在1433份患者病历中，当有治疗指征时正确选择抗生素、剂量、频率和疗程，或当无抗生素指征时适当记录不处方。次要结局包括总体抗生素使用和广谱抗生素使用。在粗双重差分分析中，指南依从性提高了26.7个百分点，校正后的干预×终点效应显示，指南依从性处方的几率更高（aOR 3.89；95% CI：1.96–7.73）。总体上，干预组抗生素使用率从96.9%降至82.2%。在一项使用所有合格病历的事后敏感性分析中，广谱抗生素使用率从83.9%降至57.5%。这些发现支持一种多组分干预的潜在价值，该干预将离线STG应用程序与培训及实施支持相结合，以改善与指南一致的抗菌药物处方；然而，移动应用程序的独立贡献无法确定。

abstract: Survival prediction frequently exhibit unstable and irreproducible performance, limiting their clinical applicability. Rather than proposing a new predictive architecture, this work presents a diagnostic investigation into the sources of this instability. Using a transformer-based deep fusion model combining RNA sequencing and histopathology data from the TCGA-BRCA cohort as a diagnostic probe, we demonstrate that global survival prediction is highly unstable across data splits. We then analyze the learned multimodal embeddings in an unsupervised manner, revealing stable latent patient subgroups with significantly divergent survival outcomes. These subgroups are not explained by canonical receptor status or immune infiltration, but instead align with tumor-intrinsic proliferative activity. Conditioning survival modeling on the largest discovered subgroup recovers strong and stable prognostic performance, substantially outperforming unimodal baselines. These findings indicate that survival predictability is conditional on latent heterogeneity and suggest that heterogeneity-aware modeling strategies are essential for robust multimodal prognostication. This work establishes a methodological framework for interpreting instability in multimodal survival learning.

abstract: [International journal of neural systems] Mental illness is becoming increasingly common in everyday life, affecting a growing number of people. Functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) is an effective technique for detecting mental disorders. Resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI) analyses spontaneous low-frequency oscillations in the Blood Oxygen Level Dependent signal to examine the functional architecture of the brain. fMRI and rs-fMRI data processing contribute to mapping neural activity in specific brain regions, enabling accurate localization of cognitive functions and improving our understanding of Functional Connectivity and interactions among brain regions. This paper focuses on the use of Machine Learning and Deep Learning techniques for fMRI analysis to identify brain features that may be associated with Bipolar Disorder (BD) and Alzheimer's Disease (AD). The first step in the proposed approach is the preprocessing of fMRI and rs-fMRI data using two distinct methods: the first combines Statistical Parametric Mapping and the CONN toolbox for improved results, and the second focuses on the MELODIC software. The proposed approach begins with fMRI and rs-fMRI preprocessing using two pipelines: one integrating Statistical Parametric Mapping (SPM) with the CONN toolbox and another based on the MELODIC framework. The aim is to evaluate how preprocessing choices affect functional connectivity representations and classification performance when combined with classical Machine Learning (ML) methods, namely Support Vector Machines and Random Forests, and the Deep Learning (DL) model AlexNet. Given the altered brain connectivity patterns observed in Bipolar Disorder and Alzheimer's Disease, these methods are employed to assess preprocessing-learning interactions across both disorders. Experimental results emphasize that Connbox-SPM preprocessing combined with AlexNet yields the best results for both mental disorders, with Bipolar Disorder reporting 78.2% accuracy and AD achieving 82.4% accuracy.

abstract: [Journal of colloid and interface science] Physiological signal acquisition is essential for medical diagnostics and human-machine interfaces. Motion artifacts and sweat-induced instability present persistent challenges for conventional electrodes, fundamentally limiting their reliability in dynamic or long-term use. Here, we report a Janus hydrogel electrode that combines high electrical conductivity (3 × 104 S·m-1), strong interfacial adhesion to copper surfaces (2079 J·m-2), and low skin-electrode impedance (∼300 Ω). Distinct from conventional Ag/AgCl electrodes, hydrogel electrode uniquely combines hydrophobic protection, high-strain impedance insensitivity (250%) and rapid self-healing, achieving interference-resistant physiological signal monitoring even under vibration and moisture interferences. Notably, coupling with advanced Transformer algorithms optimized for temporal sequence analysis, the electrodes delivered 97.02% gesture recognition accuracy. This system harnesses these gestures to generate robust and intuitive command inputs, paving the way for potential rehabilitation applications, where future clinical validation is required. This work introduces a multifunctional, biocompatible electrode platform that couples reliable physiological monitoring with AI-powered rehabilitation assessment, opening new avenues for next-generation intelligent wearable bioelectronics.

abstract: [Magnetic resonance letters] In the era of AI-driven protein structure prediction, there is an urgent demand for rapid, accessible experimental approaches to validate computationally predicted structural models or to improve the accuracy of AI-based structure determination. As a key experimental technique for determining protein structures in solution, conventional biomolecular NMR spectroscopy relies heavily on proteins labeled with 13C and 15N isotopes, a requirement that entails high experimental costs, lengthy sample preparation times, and steep technical barriers, thereby limiting its broader application. Building on our previous work, we have developed a pseudo-labeling strategy for the automated resonance assignment of unlabeled proteins. Using high-field NMR spectrometers equipped with cryoprobes, we acquired natural-abundance 1H-13C and 1H-15N heteronuclear correlation spectra directly from unlabeled samples. By integrating predicted chemical shifts of HN, Hα, 13Cα, and 15N from three complementary AI tools into an iterative simulated annealing framework with an alternating scoring scheme, our method effectively resolves severe cross-peak overlap during the automated assignment process by introducing heteronuclear dimensional constraints. This approach enables reliable automated backbone resonance assignment for unlabeled proteins exceeding 100 amino acid residues. We anticipate that this labeling-free strategy will lower the technical barrier to biomolecular NMR, enabling researchers without specialized NMR expertise to employ NMR spectroscopy in fundamental life science research and drug development.

This qualitative study elucidated patient familiarity with PtDAs and the barriers, needs, and requirements of patients to access and confidently use DAs, including when received via a clinician-facing EHR-integrated Decision Aid Navigator System (DEANS). Methods: We conducted six focus groups (FG) with participants who were recruited from two academic medical centers. Focus groups included an introduction to what a PtDA is and an exploration of how patients or family members, i.e., people who had not made a medical decision for themselves using a PtDA, but who have helped a family member, had previously used PtDAs in their healthcare. The FGs focused on PtDA-users, affordances and barriers to using PtDAs, and PtDA-user needs and requirements of a proposed DEAN patient portal. We applied Rapid Qualitative Analysis (RQA) to summarize the data, using a consensus making approach to identify emerging themes. Results: We identified three overarching themes: 1) Patients had varied familiarity with PtDAs and often confused them with general health tools, but found value in SDM, 2) Patients perceived technology accessibility, PtDA credibility, and time as barriers potentially impeding PtDA use, and 3) Patients valued flexible, user-friendly, and accessible PtDAs that support patient-led decisions, particularly when introduced by clinicians and delivered via a patient portal. Conclusion: This study provides patient-derived insights into factors that influence PtDA uptake, highlighting common misconceptions about PtDAs and identifying key patient priorities such as accessibility, flexibility, clear content, and clinician-guided usage. Patient also expected clinicians to be familiar with PtDAs, especially when the PtDA covers a complex decision. These findings can inform the development of more patient-centered SDM infrastructure and strategies to support PtDA use in clinical practice, including clinician-supported delivery, accessibility, and integration into routine care to strengthen shared decision-making.
